offering_description.value: Sells cloud software for managing HR and payroll to employers, including businesses and public agencies. The platform uses a single database to automate work from hiring and timekeeping through payroll.

quotes.quote: Paycom is a cloud-based human capital management (HCM) software provider that helps organizations manage payroll and HR in one place. Built on a single database, Paycom automates the employee life cycle — from hiring to payroll to time and labor — while reducing the manual work created by disconnected tools.
Read how Paycom simplified hiring, payroll, compliance and more for the Waukegan Park District so it could focus on guests — not HR issues.
